suite: the DAG zoom, Fit and the grid header
expect_red: [real] a study change moves the DAG as one continuous frame: the space before it and the scroll are part of the transition, with no snap at either end, both ways

mutations.contract: The space a study arrival puts before the drawing is part of the transition: its first frame wears the pad the reader was looking at and its last wears the one it lands in.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff the_dag_holds_still_and_the_filter_bar_stays_put (2026-11-03). The transition frames draw with no pad at all, which is the 10-29 landing: the drawing jumps left on the first frame and back to centre on the last.
mutations.find:
ctx.bandPad = { top: lerp(start.pad.top, end.pad.top, e),
                        left: lerp(start.pad.left, end.pad.left, e) };

mutations.contract: A study arrival never puts space to the drawing's left: that space is between the pane's edge and the grid too.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff the_grid_fits_the_screen_and_its_brackets_say_what_nests_in_what (2026-11-05). Puts a fixed left pad back.
